content_note: Every rule here is intent-only: a name, an id and a logic line that names the detections the rule would join. There is no query, schedule, severity or alert mapping, so nothing in this file can be imported into a tenant as-is. Author the rule in the XSIAM console from the logic line.

rules.logic: (BIOC(NGFW EAL — long FQDN exceeding host baseline) OR (XQL(NGFW EAL — anomalous DNS query volume from single source) AND XQL(NGFW EAL — high-entropy DNS labels (base32 character profile))) OR XQL(NGFW EAL — TXT query burst from single host)) AND XQL(XSIAM stitching — DNS exfil + endpoint process lineage correlated) stitched by src_host within 300s
rules.name: DNS Tunneling Exfiltration — Volume Entropy And Length
